chunks: Never does a new reminder come to them from Ar-Rahman but they turn away from it.
ai.seo_question: Why did the early disbelievers turn away from the Quran when it was recited to them?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ya-Sin, this verse highlights the psychological stubbornness of the Quraysh, who rejected the Quran not due to lack of clarity, but because of their entrenched arrogance and preference for ancestral traditions. Shia exegetes often link this 'turning away' to the concept of *'urfah* (spiritual blindness) that prevents the heart from recognizing the truth even when presented as a fresh, divine reminder.
